title: Implement LayerNorm
hint: Normalize over the last dim: (x - mean) / sqrt(var + eps), then scale by gamma and shift by beta.

description.text: Implement layer normalization over the last dimension: normalize x using mean and variance along dim=-1, then apply learnable scale gamma and shift beta.

examples.input: x shape (B, T, D); gamma, beta shape (D,)
examples.output: Last dim zero-mean unit-var (before gamma/beta); same outer shape as x.
examples.explanation: Mean/variance computed over the last axis only.

constraints: Normalize over the last dimension only.
Use epsilon inside the sqrt for variance.
Do not use F.layer_norm or nn.LayerNorm.
